# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_RIBBON_EXPANSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In low VIX regimes (VIX_close < 12), a bullish ribbon alignment (EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50) with price above VWAP(20) signals a sustained upward drift. This setup captures the edge of quiet markets where trend-following via EMA expansion and VWAP support can produce consistent gains.

## Mechanism

Entry: IF VIX_close < 12 AND EMA9 > EMA20 AND EMA20 > EMA50 AND price > VWAP(20) THEN go long at the close of the bar.
Exit: Stop at VWAP (chart-stop) or prior swing low, whichever is higher; target at 2x risk or trail using a chandelier exit after 1.5R profit.
Regime: Time 09:45-14:30 EST, avoid first 15 min and last 30 min; low VIX (<12) ensures quiet backdrop for ribbon expansion to work.
